name: querybridge-ai
description: Full-stack RAG platform that turns Google Drive knowledge into AI-powered answers using React, n8n, Pinecone, OpenAI, Gmail, and Google Sheets.

paragraphs: Document-grounded answers from a secure submission form to your inbox.

QueryBridge AI is a full-stack question-answering platform. A responsive React form accepts a visitor's contact details and question; a Vercel Function validates and forwards the request to an authenticated n8n webhook. n8n retrieves relevant Google Drive knowledge from Pinecone, asks OpenAI for a grounded response, sends user and administrator email through Gmail, and records the outcome in Google Sheets. The live website's primary production happy path was manually verified on October 9, 2026.
features: Same-origin React → Express/Vercel API with shared Zod validation and server-only webhook credentials.
Authenticated n8n webhook that returns HTTP 202 acceptance before asynchronous RAG processing.
Native Pinecone Vector Store and OpenAI nodes, not a generic AI Agent or hand-built search endpoint.
Google Drive ingestion with source-aware chunks and explicit text-embedding-3-small embeddings.
Top-five Pinecone retrieval, GPT-4o mini grounded generation, HTML-safe Gmail messages, and ten-column Sheets logging.

whatItDoes.text: Document-grounded answers from a secure submission form to your inbox.
